common_architecture.activation: same activation for every graph operator
common_architecture.dropout: same probability and placement for every graph operator
common_architecture.edge_index: fixed 4x4 bidirectional physical mesh with 48 directed edges; no learned or scenario-dependent edges
common_architecture.graph_width: equal to the B3 temporal encoder output width; G1 preflight must resolve and record the numeric width from frozen model source before training
common_architecture.residual_policy: same residual policy for every graph operator
common_architecture.temporal_encoder: unchanged B3 causal depthwise-separable Conv1D encoder

gat.attention_normalization: softmax over incoming neighbors including self
gat.head_count: single common head configuration frozen in G1 preflight

gcnconv.equation: H' = D_hat^(-1/2) A_hat D_hat^(-1/2) H W + b

graphconv.equation: h'_i = W_root h_i + W_neigh sum_{j in N(i)} h_j + b
graphconv.rtl_preference_reason: fixed neighbor lists, degree <= 4, additions plus two linear transforms, no attention softmax
